qualification_scope: Official Linux binary identity and CLI capabilities, upstream wrapper-relevant source delta review, loopback-only doctor probes, and deterministic child-environment regression. No live provider authentication, tunnel provisioning, or foreign-platform execution.
compatibility_findings: The existing run/config/static-key/health/log CLI capabilities remain available; the runtime minimum is unchanged.

The new stdio failure policy is parsed even with an HTTP MCP target. An unrelated invalid MCP_STDIO_FAILURE_POLICY blocks startup. Prodex now removes that ambient setting alongside its existing transport configuration isolation, without adding a new flag or YAML key that older compatible clients would reject.

Request-ID response metadata is additive. DNS diagnostics are bounded and do not change resolver or retry behavior. The reviewed generation changes fence stale stdio-child connections; Prodex continues to use its existing HTTP MCP endpoint.
Redis development-proxy retirement does not change the run invocation used by Prodex.
successful_probes: doctor --json with the exact Prodex YAML shape, synthetic static key and loopback-only MCP/OAuth endpoints

regression.baseline: Failed before the environment filter change: the conflicting stdio policy remained in the child environment.
regression.after_fix: All four openai_tunnel version/environment policy tests pass with real Mojo required.
regression.official_binary_confirmation: The official binary reports invalid MCP_STDIO_FAILURE_POLICY with an unrelated ambient value, then passes all mandatory doctor checks without it. The optional Codex plugin discovery check was skipped in the deliberately isolated HOME/PATH.
